portsOfCall.description: Board American Constellation in Seattle (some sailings use Tacoma) — a small American-flagged ship of about 100–175 guests.
portsOfCall.name: Seattle, WA

portsOfCall.description: Gateway to the San Juans — Washington Park and Cap Sante views.
portsOfCall.name: Anacortes, WA

portsOfCall.description: Whale Museum, Lime Kiln Point orca viewing, and lavender farms.
portsOfCall.name: Friday Harbor, San Juan Island

portsOfCall.description: Narrow passages among the islands — watch for orcas, porpoises and bald eagles.
portsOfCall.name: San Juan Islands scenic cruising

portsOfCall.description: Hurricane Ridge in Olympic National Park; optional ferry day to Victoria, BC.
portsOfCall.name: Port Angeles, WA

portsOfCall.description: Victorian seaport, Fort Worden and maritime history.
portsOfCall.name: Port Townsend, WA

portsOfCall.description: 'Little Norway' — Scandinavian bakeries and a waterfront boardwalk.
portsOfCall.name: Poulsbo, WA

portsOfCall.description: Return to the Seattle area (some sailings end in Tacoma).
portsOfCall.name: Seattle, WA

cabinCategories.description: Spacious stateroom with private balcony — the most common category on American's small ships.
Suite with separate sitting area and large balcony.

amenityHighlights: Shore excursions included in each port
Docks right in town — no tenders
inclusions: All meals and beverages including wine & beer
Guided shore excursion in every port
diningOptions: Single open-seating dining room with regional Pacific Northwest menus
reviewSnippet: Puget Sound & San Juan Islands without leaving Washington: a small, all-inclusive American Constellation voyage with orca country, Friday Harbor and Olympic National Park — a cruise for Seattle locals who want something closer to home. — Editor's note
